tasks.name: Convert JSON to XML string
tasks.prompt:
Write a Python function json_to_xml(data: dict, root_name: str = 'root') -> str that converts a JSON/dict object to an XML string. Simple values become elements. Nested dicts become nested elements. Lists become repeated elements. Return only the function definition.

Example:
Input: {"name": "Alice", "age": 30, "hobbies": ["reading", "cycling"]}
Expected XML-like output: <root><name>Alice</name><age>30</age><hobbies>reading</hobbies><hobbies>cycling</hobbies></root>
